# POWER NOTE ON THE LOST SET
The lost-promoter null is underpowered, not a demonstrated absence of effect:
downsampling the gained set to n=127 recovers its own effect only 27% of the time,
and the direction test itself rests on only 33 significant genes.
The interpretable lost-side result is depletion at active promoters (Supplementary Figure S3A).
